card.name: Physics and Nobel Prize passages
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (then, if, and, commas, digits in years) inside physics text, especially on quantum entanglement and Nobel Prize in Physics winners.

modes.label: Entanglement explanation
modes.description: Linking words in the sentences explaining entangled particles and measuring one to know the other.
modes.example: If two particles are entangled,<< then>> we can know the state of one particle
